reviewed_properties.evidence: The complete current runtime tree includes install stdlib/shared libraries/data/native tools, licenses, old qualification evidence and current raw logs/metadata. Full original inventory and alias authority is checked before scan. Root mode700, explicit directory and file modes, bounded regular single-link files and exact internal sibling aliases are preserved. Unknown aliases, escaping targets, directory links, hardlinks and special files are refused. The original qualified install prefix is required on both sides. No relocation or binary patch is allowed.

Packing explicitly uses USTAR without a PAX fallback. Every complete entry has a bounded safe path/schema/mode/type/size/hash and every parent is a directory. The validator checks exact archive member universe, duplication, canonical header metadata and offsets, body bytes and link targets. Full producer archive SHA and size additionally bind every archive byte. This review does not independently rerun the author10113-name USTAR data check.

Helper and candidate are required equal complete SHA parameters with actual helper HEAD. The export manifest binds the source group, current repository/run/attempt, actual qualified prefix, full entries and archive bytes. Restore requires the exact producer manifest SHA plus same-run uploaded artifact ID/name/API digest/current run/expiry. API head_sha remains workflow-context observation and is not relabelled as helper source.

Restore checks the complete archive before creating the fresh runtime output. It creates directories and regular files first, then exact internal aliases. It rechecks the entire restored tree, original validators, input archive/manifest and source identities afterward. The adapter does not execute installed native code or start a service. Context.admitted_runtime remains required before product use.

Both restore outputs must be new disjoint RUNNER_TEMP descendants outside repository and capsule inputs. Existing outputs are refused. Restore keeps separate API-origin and finally-written restore receipt, retaining failure state. Source/pre-output failures remain CLI/job raw logs. Export keeps partial transport/failure files and grants no manifest success when its before/after qualification comparison fails.

Every transport result keeps product readiness and acceptance false. Historical runtime receipts and environment bytes remain exact. A transport receipt neither substitutes old compiler results nor establishes formal product acceptance.
